title: オブジェクト指向プログラミング
subtitle: Object Oriented Programming
teachers:
SATOU Fujio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1) Learn the concepts and practices of object-oriented programming in Java.
(2) Learn the basics of classes and how to use objects.
(3) Gain a deep understanding of the above by creating and running Java programs and verifying their behavior.
advice:
This is a course in object-oriented programming and the Java language.

We will cover the following materials:
 - Overview of object-oriented programming and Java, Installation of development environment
 - Java basics
 - Class, encapsulation, constructor
 - Class library, string
 - Class inheritance, interface
 - Exception handling, input/output
 - Multithread
 - GUI, event processing

(2) Be able to create programs by combining the learned techniques.
